summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K reporting routine daily ASX disclosure tied to its previously announced stock repurchase program, under which up to $1 billion in aggregate Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock may be acquired from time to time. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 reproduce the ASX daily buy-back notices; no specific shares, prices, or completion dates are stated. No advisor, premium, or board recommendation appears. The program leaves ongoing buyback capacity and signal value; watch actual repurchase pace and pricing as indications of management's valuation view and capital-return commitment.
